payload.documentation: Rural/Urban Filters: Only apply filters on the 'location_of_head_quarter' column if the user explicitly mentions 'Rural' or 'Urban' in their question.
Latest Data logic: To fetch the most current rankings accurately, use the subquery pattern: CAST(date_time AS DATE) = (SELECT MAX(CAST(date_time AS DATE)) FROM ...).
Mandatory Sorting: ALL ranking list queries MUST use 'ORDER BY flag ASC, rank ASC'. The 'flag' column handles high-level business prioritizations and must take precedence over 'rank'.
Rank Types: Supported levels are 'State', 'District', and 'Block (State Nodal)'. Queries default to 'State' level if location granularity is not specified. Use the 'rank_type_name' column to filter.
PACS Sector Filter: Every PACS query must use the combined triplet for accurate coverage: (sector_name ILIKE '%PACS%' OR sector_name ILIKE '%LAMPS%' OR sector_name ILIKE '%FSS%').
Quarterly Record Logic: Data for a quarter is recorded on the 1st day of the following month. Q1 (Jan-Mar) = Apr 1st; Q2 (Apr-Jun) = Jul 1st; Q3 (Jul-Sep) = Oct 1st; Q4 (Oct-Dec) = Jan 1st.
Sector Name Variants: Only UCB has an alternative name mapping: UCB includes 'Urban Cooperative Bank'. For all other sectors, use the standard sector name from the schema.
Ranking Source Table: All ranking data is pulled from the materialized view 'public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings'. This is the single source of truth for ranks and scores.
